pages.text: Farmer's Delight runs the kitchen. Raw food still works, but real meals feed you longer, give $(bold)Nourishment$() (slow natural regen) and $(bold)Comfort$() (faster healing).$(br2)Start with a knife and a cutting board; the pot and skillet come once you have iron.
Right-click food onto it, then right-click with a knife. Cabbage into leaves, meat into cuts, rice into grains.
Sits on a heat source: campfire, stove, fire, magma. Soups, stews and rice dishes come out of here. A bowl in the left slot serves them.
Fries meat and eggs in your hand or on a stove. The stove below is the kitchen's heart: a campfire you can cook several things on at once.
Build the stove under a cooking pot. Rich soil (compost) grows crops faster in any season that allows them.

$(bold)Fish:$() Aquaculture gives rods, hooks and bait. Rivers, lakes and oceans hold different fish; some are heavy, some are worth emeralds. A worm farm turns dirt and seeds into bait.$(br2)$(bold)Aquaculture Delight$() adds the recipes that turn a catch into a meal.
Rods take a hook and bait; a worm farm breeds the bait.

Season matters: see $(l:patchouli:land/crops)What Grows When$(). Out of season, crops stop; a greenhouse roof or a deep farm keeps the pot full.$(br2)Animals are from Animania and are a chapter of their own: $(l:patchouli:start/animals)Animals$()
